title: The Greater Lunar Canon
summary: A canon of the heavy lunar weight that pins a strong foe and the full radiance that pushes a front of foes outward.

title: The Moon Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches how to spread lunar pull and glow through the living field so a distant foe is seized and the unseen is lit.

title: Manual of the Paired Phases
summary: A manual of the bright half and the dark half used together so a blow lands on the false face and not the true.

title: Canon of the Basin Tide
summary: A canon on gathering the pull of the field in a basin and loosing it as a river of force.

title: The Wind-Sworn Tide Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wind-sworn moon-binder who sets a bearing against the tide and pulls foes round it.

title: Plateau Manual of the Far Pull
summary: A Xiantian manual of the long pull and push that reaches far across the open with no wall to block it.
